# Celts

The Celts hadmigrated to Britaina few centuries before thearrival ofthe Romans, butthearrival of Germanic tribes pushed them further west, until their strongholds were in Scotland, Ireland,Wale,d Cornwall. Their art survived these disruptions, bridging the transition frompaganism to Christianity.This is most obvious from their metalwork.The designs on their weaponryand horse-trappings were still beingused, centuries later,on chalices, croziers, and shrines.

In their stoneworkand manuscripts the Christian Celts broke new ground. In Ireland, they developed a style ofmonumental high cross, lavishly decorated with biblical scenes. And manuscripts like the Book ofKells (see pp.70-71) won much admiration.
